description:
Rental listings live right now in the suburb, with address, weekly rent
and the advertised rent line, beds/baths/cars, coordinates, an `off_market`
flag and the leasing agency. Same paging, filters and withholding rule as
for-sale.

limit.description: Max listings to return (default 30, max 200). `total` always reports the full match count.

off_market.description: Only return OFF-MARKET listings: not on the major listing portals, sourced from the agency's own site, and still believed live — our Property Finder's 'Off market only' rule. Default false returns every listing, each carrying its own `off_market` flag. `total` counts the filtered set.

offset.description: Listing offset — page with `limit`. `next_offset` in the response is the value for the next page (null on the last).

verbose.description: Include the agent's full ad-copy in `attributes.description`. Off by default.

name: suburbs_listings_for_rent
title: Suburb · Current rental listings
